event.title: Australia Takes 101-Run Lead Against Bangladesh in Second Test
event.canonical_title: Australia Takes 101-Run Lead Against Bangladesh in Second Test
event.summary: In the second Test match against Bangladesh, Australia established a 101-run lead after bowling Bangladesh out for just 64 runs in their first innings. The match saw a total of 18 wickets fall on the first day, with Australia's left-arm bowlers playing a crucial role in the wicket-taking spree. Australia ended the day at 50 for 3 in their second innings.

timeline.title: Starc Leads Australia to Dominant Victory Over Bangladesh in Second Test
timeline.summary: Mitchell Starc took 10 wickets as Australia defeated Bangladesh by an innings and 51 runs in the second Test. Australia bounced back from their previous loss, bowling out Bangladesh for just 64 and 95 runs in Mackay.
